title_zh: 陈景润：痴迷数学的「哥德巴赫猜想」研究者
title_en: Famous Chinese People (17/20): Chen Jingrun, the Mathematician Obsessed with the Goldbach Conjecture
note_en: Foreign names are written in Chinese with characters chosen for their sound, not their meaning: 哥德巴赫 (Gēdébāhè) is simply "Goldbach," and 帕金森病 (Pàjīnsēn bìng) is "Parkinson's disease." Don't try to read 哥 "elder brother" or 德 "virtue" into the name. A useful habit: when a string of characters makes no sense word by word, say it aloud and listen for a foreign name.
